content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta version seems to reveal a lot of information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include an all-new HomePod mini, a security camera, a next-generation Siri remote for the new Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad product.

After delving into the code, it also seems to provide many important clues about the appearance of HomePad……

Engadget's Filipe Espósito found various signs indicating that while HomePad is likely to run some version of tvOS, it may operate more like a giant Apple Watch.

The code also points to a rather interesting privacy feature: HomePad will only display your personal information in widgets when it detects your iPhone is nearby.

We expect HomePad to come in two versions, one with a speaker base that may resemble a HomePod in appearance, and another expected to be used for wall mounting.

Besides the other Apple home products mentioned above, some unknown new devices are also mentioned. Personally, I'm really hoping that includes a smart doorbell. What Apple home products are you particularly looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
